name: Colour City Internet
summary: Orange NSW local ISP, internet arm of Colour City Computers; the largest privately-owned public-access network in Central West NSW; live regional ISP still in 2010, defunct thereafter.

events.details: Business commenced early 1995 as Colour City Computers; commenced own internet service February 2000 with dial-up and broadband access.

refs.label: Colour City Internet about page — Feb 2000

events.details: Still a live regional ISP in Feb 2010 (Wayback: Colour City Computers running "the largest privately-owned public-access IT network" in Central West NSW); no captures after early 2010, defunct thereafter.

The ABR entity CITY COLOUR PTY. LIMITED (ACN 053 114 524) previously cited here is a name collision — it is a Sydney photo/framing business (trading as PHOTOLAND, later Sydney Frames & Photos), not the Orange NSW ISP Colour City Computers. Gov ref removed.
